bio: Hello Sailor, the younger sibling of nearby Kindred, occupies a prime position overlooking Lake Norman, and the two outdoor terraces are the place to be when the weather is nice (though inside by the wood-burning stove is certainly no consolation prize when winter arrives). While this neighborhood spot that works for all occasions could rest on its setting alone, the menu ticks all the boxes. Its lakeside location means you'll find plenty of seafood on the menu, and PEI mussels and oysters with a glass of wine or cocktail is never a bad idea. Friendly service completes the sunny picture....
